title: Sweden’s Election Result Remains Too Close to Call
subtitle: The country faces a long wait for a new government as two political blocs are separated by a single seat.

summary.en: Sweden's general election has resulted in an extremely tight race between the center-left and center-right political blocs. With most votes counted, the opposition led by the Social Democrats holds a very narrow lead. Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has urged patience while the final ballots are processed. The far-right Sweden Democrats have seen a drop in support compared to previous years. The process of forming a new government could take several weeks or even months.
summary.zh: 瑞典大選導致中間偏左與中間偏右兩大政治陣營陷入極度激烈的競爭。在大部分選票完成計票後，由社會民主黨領導的反對派陣營取得極微小的領先。總理克里斯特森呼籲在處理剩餘選票期間保持耐心。極右翼的瑞典民主黨支持率較往年有所下降。籌組新政府的過程可能需要數週甚至數個月的時間。

paragraphs.en: Sweden is currently waiting for a final result in its general election, as the race between the two main political blocs remains too close to call. According to reports from the Swedish election authority and the public broadcaster SVT, the center-left opposition bloc led by former Prime Minister Magdalena Andersson is currently ahead by a single seat in parliament. As of Monday morning, with over 90% of the votes counted, the opposition was projected to hold 175 seats compared to 174 for the governing center-right coalition.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞典目前正等待大選的最終結果，由於兩大政治陣營之間的競爭過於激烈，勝負難分。根據瑞典選舉當局與公共廣播公司瑞典電視台（SVT）的報導，由前總理安德森（Magdalena Andersson）領導的中間偏左反對派陣營，目前在國會中以一席之差領先。截至週一上午，在超過百分之九十的選票完成計票後，預測反對派將取得一百七十五席，而執政的中間偏右聯盟則為一百七十四席。

paragraphs.en: This election has been defined by a very small margin of difference between the two sides. BBC News noted that with 50% of the votes counted, the two blocs were separated by only 20,000 votes. Because the gap is so narrow, officials do not expect a final, confirmed result until at least Wednesday. Both major political groups are now waiting for the remaining ballots to be processed before they can determine who will lead the country for the next term.
paragraphs.zh: 這場選舉的特點在於雙方差距極小。英國廣播公司新聞網（BBC News）指出，在百分之五十的選票完成計票時，兩大陣營的票數差距僅有兩萬票。由於差距如此微小，官員預計至少要到週三才能獲得最終的確認結果。目前兩大政治集團都在等待剩餘選票完成處理，才能確定誰將領導國家進入下一個任期。

paragraphs.en: Magdalena Andersson, who leads the Social Democratic Party, has expressed confidence in the current projections. According to Deutsche Welle, she told her supporters that while the situation is very close, she is prepared to take responsibility for the result. Andersson stated that if the current lead holds, Sweden will have a new government. Her campaign has focused on the need for cooperation and a new direction for the country’s leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 領導社會民主黨（Social Democratic Party）的安德森對目前的預測結果表示有信心。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，她向支持者表示，儘管選情非常膠著，但她已準備好為結果負責。安德森指出，若目前的領先優勢能維持，瑞典將會出現一個新政府。她的競選主軸聚焦於國家領導層需要合作與新的發展方向。

paragraphs.en: On the other side, incumbent Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has asked for patience. He suggested that it is still unclear which government will lead Sweden in the coming years. Kristersson noted that he intends to speak with other party leaders to explore options for forming a majority. He also expressed some doubt about whether the opposition parties, which have different goals, will be able to agree on a common program to govern effectively. Kristersson’s own campaign has focused heavily on reducing violent crime and managing immigration, which were key issues for voters during this election cycle.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，現任總理克里斯特森（Ulf Kristersson）則呼籲大眾保持耐心。他表示，目前仍不清楚未來幾年將由哪個政府領導瑞典。克里斯特森指出，他打算與其他政黨領袖進行對話，以探索籌組多數政府的選項。他也對目標各異的反對黨是否能就共同的執政綱領達成共識表示懷疑。克里斯特森個人的競選重點則高度集中在減少暴力犯罪與管理移民問題，這些都是本屆選舉週期中選民關注的核心議題。

paragraphs.en: A significant development in this election is the performance of the Sweden Democrats, a far-right party that has been a major force in recent years. According to Deutsche Welle, the party appears to be losing support for the first time since 2010. While they had hoped to enter the government for the first time, their share of the vote has dropped by more than three percentage points compared to the 2022 election. Despite this, Kristersson had previously promised the party key government roles, such as the position of migration minister, if his coalition won the election.
paragraphs.zh: 這場選舉的一個重大發展是瑞典民主黨（Sweden Democrats）的表現，該極右翼政黨近年來已成為一股主要勢力。根據德國之聲報導，該黨的支持率似乎自二零一零年以來首次出現下滑。儘管他們曾希望首次進入政府執政，但其得票率與二零二二年大選相比下降了超過三個百分點。儘管如此，克里斯特森先前曾承諾，若其聯盟贏得選舉，將給予該黨關鍵的政府職位，例如移民部長一職。

paragraphs.en: The political landscape in Sweden is often complex, as the country typically features two major blocs made up of four parties each. Because of this structure, forming a government often requires building a coalition — an agreement where different parties work together to gain a majority. The current deadlock suggests that this process could take a long time. The Guardian reported that given the current results, it could take weeks or even months before a new government is officially formed.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞典的政治版圖通常相當複雜，該國政壇通常由兩個主要陣營組成，每個陣營各包含四個政黨。由於這種結構，籌組政府往往需要建立聯盟，即透過不同政黨間的協議來取得多數席次。目前的僵局顯示，這個過程可能需要很長的時間。衛報（The Guardian）報導稱，鑑於目前的結果，新政府正式成立可能需要數週甚至數個月的時間。

paragraphs.en: For many Swedish voters, this election was about choosing between two very different visions for the country. The Social Democrats have been a major force in Swedish politics since the end of World War Two and have promised to strengthen the welfare state and address rising costs for families. Meanwhile, the right-wing alliance has argued that their approach to crime and immigration is what the country needs. Supporters of the right-wing bloc believe that their record in government shows they can get things done, while critics argue that their policies could harm civil liberties.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多瑞典選民而言，這場選舉是在為國家選擇兩種截然不同的願景。社會民主黨自第二次世界大戰結束以來一直是瑞典政壇的主要力量，並承諾將強化福利國家制度，並解決家庭生活成本上升的問題。與此同時，右翼聯盟則主張他們對犯罪與移民問題的處理方式才是國家所需。右翼陣營的支持者認為，他們過去的執政紀錄證明他們有能力解決問題，而批評者則認為他們的政策可能會損害公民自由。

paragraphs.en: As the country waits for the final count, the atmosphere remains tense. With eight million people eligible to vote and a high turnout typically exceeding 80%, the stakes are high. Both leaders are now waiting to see if the final numbers confirm the current projections. Regardless of the outcome, the small margin of victory means that the next government will face the difficult task of leading a country that is clearly divided on its future path.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著國家等待最終計票結果，氣氛依然緊張。瑞典有八百萬名合格選民，且投票率通常超過百分之八十，這使得選舉結果至關重要。兩位領袖目前都在等待最終數據是否能證實目前的預測。無論結果如何，微小的勝負差距意味著下屆政府將面臨艱鉅的任務，必須領導一個在未來道路上明顯分裂的國家。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A competition between candidates to be elected to a position.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「賽跑」，這裡指政治上的競選。文中：as the race between the two main political blocs remains too close to call.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To announce the result of a competition or election before it is officially finished.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「打電話」或「呼叫」，這裡指預測選舉結果。文中：as the race between the two main political blocs remains too close to call.
常見作「拿著」，這裡指目前的領先狀態維持不變。文中：Andersson stated that if the current lead holds, Sweden will have a new government.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A person or thing that has a lot of influence or power.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 有影響力的人或事物；勢力。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「力量」或「武力」，這裡指政壇上的影響力。文中：a far-right party that has been a major force in recent years.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Sweden's recent general election has resulted in an extremely close race between two main political blocs. Early projections show the center-left opposition leading by only a single seat in parliament. The incumbent government, led by Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson, has worked closely with the hard-right Sweden Democrats. Meanwhile, former Prime Minister Magdalena Andersson and her Social Democrats are hoping to return to power. Officials have asked the public to be patient while every single vote is counted to ensure a fair result.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the Sweden Democrats according to the article?

options.A: They have successfully secured a position as the new governing party.
options.B: They are experiencing a decline in voter support for the first time since 2010.
options.C: They have gained more influence than they had in the 2022 election.
options.D: They have officially withdrawn from the coalition led by Ulf Kristersson.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第五段，瑞典民主黨（Sweden Democrats）的支持率自 2010 年以來首次出現下滑，且比 2022 年大選時減少了超過三個百分點。選項 A 錯誤，因為他們尚未執政；選項 C 與文章事實相反；選項 D 錯誤，因為文中並未提到他們退出聯盟，僅提到支持率下降。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the formation of a new government in Sweden be particularly difficult?

options.A: Because the Swedish election authority has refused to release the final vote count.
options.B: Because the two main candidates have refused to speak to each other.
options.C: Because the narrow margin of victory makes it hard to build a stable, unified coalition.
options.D: Because the constitution requires a unanimous vote from all eight million eligible voters.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第六段提到瑞典政治結構複雜，通常需透過聯盟（coalition）來取得多數，而目前的僵局（deadlock）源於雙方票數極為接近。這暗示了無論哪一方勝出，要在意見分歧的國會中建立一個穩定的多數聯盟將極具挑戰性。選項 A 錯誤，因為延遲是因計票程序；選項 B 文中未提及；選項 D 則完全不符合瑞典的民主選舉制度。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, what does the word 'margin' mean in the context of 'a very small margin of difference'?

options.A: The blank space at the edge of a printed page.
options.B: The profit made by a company on a single product.
options.C: The amount or degree of difference between two things.
options.D: A physical boundary or fence surrounding a property.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在文中，'margin' 指的是兩個政治陣營在得票數上的差距（gap）。選項 A 是該詞的字面義（頁邊空白），但在本句中不適用；選項 B 是商業用語（利潤率），與政治選舉無關；選項 D 是實體界線的意思，與文中描述的數據差距無關。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main message of the article?

options.A: The Swedish election has been cancelled due to widespread voter fraud.
options.B: The Social Democrats have already been declared the absolute winners of the election.
options.C: Sweden is facing a period of political uncertainty due to an extremely close election result.
options.D: The Sweden Democrats are the only party that has a clear vision for the country's future.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章的核心在於描述瑞典大選因兩大陣營票數過於接近，導致結果難以預測，且未來籌組政府的過程將充滿不確定性與挑戰。選項 A 與事實不符；選項 B 錯誤，因為結果尚未確認；選項 D 僅是文章其中一個細節，並非整篇文章的主旨。
